subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir pequenos relatos de observação de processos, de fatos, de experiências pessoais, mantendo as características do gênero, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Planejar um relato observacional selecionando eventos ou experiências relevantes
components.description_en: Plan a brief observational account by selecting relevant events or experiences
components.cc_component_description: Incorporate relevant descriptive details to develop events or convey experiences vividly

components.description_pt: Produzir um relato observacional mantendo as características do gênero
components.description_en: Produce a brief observational account maintaining the characteristics of the genre
components.cc_component_description: Describe attributes and characteristics of a topic using facts and definitions

components.description_pt: Adaptar o conteúdo de um relato observacional à situação comunicativa e tema
components.description_en: Adapt the content of an observational account to the communicative situation and topic
components.cc_component_description: Adapt the organization, style, and substance of a presentation to suit its purpose and audience

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will construct informational texts in language arts that
* Introduce and define topic __and/or entity__ for audience
* Describe __attributes and characteristics with facts, definitions, and relevant details__
Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, relevant descriptive details, and well-structured event sequences.

Present information, findings, and supporting evidence, conveying a clear and distinct perspective, such that listeners can follow the line of reasoning, alternative or opposing perspectives are addressed, and the organization, development, substance, and style are appropriate to purpose, audience, and a range of formal and informal tasks.
